evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT stayed around -13% to -15% and WORKPLACES near zero or slightly negative in the snapshot
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not fall relative to the last 28 days even though TRANSIT remains below -10 and WORKPLACES stays below 0 for most of the next four weeks.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was positive in all four observed weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises or fails to decline in the two weeks after RESIDENTIAL stays at or above +5 for two straight weeks.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not move lower in the week after TRANSIT falls by more than 2 points from its current weekly mean.
